stances.summary: Condemns Iranian regime's execution of protesters, warns against trusting Iran
stances.quote:
Since March, the Iranian regime has executed 56 people—many publicly hanged for the “crime” of protesting their government.

A regime willing to treat its own people so barbarically cannot be trusted to ever stop threatening the same terror toward the outside world.

stances.summary: Iran will not abandon nuclear program; only funding restrictions will work
stances.quote: Iran will never follow through on ending nuclear production nor giving up its new found leverage in the Strait of Hormuz. They are attempting to play us….again. The only way to stop them is to eliminate their avenues of funding. Period.

stances.summary: Warns Iran threatens U.S. homeland through cyber and unconventional attacks
stances.quote: Iran doesn't need missiles to threaten us, they will bring this fight to American soil however they can. Cyber attacks are just one of the weapons they will use.

stances.summary: Calls for enforcing sanctions against China for re-arming Iran
stances.quote:
China isn’t just buying Iranian oil— it’s re-arming the regime. 

We need to enforce the sanctions against China now.

stances.summary: China and Russia enabling Iranian regime threatens U.S. security
stances.quote: Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin cannot be trusted. We can't be naive to the fact they are aiding the Iranian regime.

stances.summary: Iran poses global threat; allies must cooperate against regime
stances.quote: Iran is a threat to the entire free world, not just America. It’s in our allies' best interest to accept that and help us.

stances.summary: China and Russia provide satellite imagery to Iranian regime
stances.quote: It is important to remember that yes, Iran struck our military bases and killed and injured many soldiers but who is giving them the satellite imagery to do so? China and Russia.

stances.summary: Cut off Iranian regime funding to weaken threat and secure America
stances.quote:
Every dollar the Iranian regime gets its hands on fuels more terror. We need to work with our allies to cut off every single dollar. 

That’s how we weaken the regime for good and ensure America’s security.

stances.summary: Discusses Iran policy, Trump administration, NATO implications
stances.quote: Nikki Haley on Iran, Trump, NATO and America's Next Move

stances.summary: U.S. must demonstrate willingness to finish Iran conflict decisively
stances.quote:
How we handle Iran matters far beyond the Middle East. 

Our enemies are watching. They need to understand we are willing to finish the job for our own national security and the security of our allies.

stances.summary: Iran must be prevented from threatening Americans permanently
stances.quote: Finish the job. Make sure Iran never has the ability to threaten Americans again.

stances.summary: Iranian regime will not abandon nuclear ambitions or terror funding
stances.quote:
It’s always been crystal clear that the Iranian regime won’t give up its nuclear ambitions or stop funding its terrorist proxies. 

That’s why we need to make the tough decisions required for our national security.

stances.summary: Criticizes Washington spending and growing national debt
stances.quote:
America is about to hit $40 trillion in debt this week. 

That’s over $300,000 for every household in America. 

Washington keeps spending money we don’t have like the bill is never coming due.

👇

stances.summary: Calls for Republicans to cut spending and prioritize affordability
stances.quote:
"The U.S. government now spends more money just on interest than it does to fund the entire US Military or to provide healthcare for seniors.”

Every Republican should address this going into the midterms and commit to cutting spending and focusing on affordability.

stances.summary: Criticizes national debt crisis, warns politicians ignoring generational impact
stances.quote:
In the next two weeks, our country will hit $40 trillion in debt. It’s one of the biggest problems facing young Americans right now, yet politicians in Washington and around the country aren’t even discussing it. 

We’re leaving an entire generation broke.

stances.summary: Criticizes government spending and congressional inaction on debt crisis
stances.quote: Washington is borrowing $60,000 a second and paying $24 BILLION a week in interest alone. Our national debt is spiraling while the House is on summer vacation and the Senate can’t wait to take their own.

stances.summary: Supports disarming Hamas as path to Palestinian security and terror-free Gaza
stances.quote: Disarming Hamas isn’t just good for Israel. It’s also the path to a terror free Gaza for Palestinians. Everyone should want it to succeed.

stances.summary: Focus on Iranian regime threat, not Israel; Iran targets Americans
stances.quote:
The people blaming Israel for situation in the Middle East need to stop talking about Israel and start focusing on the Iranian regime. 

They are the ones trying to kill Americans on American soil.

stances.summary: Democrats oppose Israel; invokes biblical support for Jewish state
stances.quote:
Democrats have drawn a reprehensible line in the sand when it comes to Israel. 

“I will bless those who bless you, and whoever curses you I will curse; and all peoples on earth will be blessed through you” — Genesis 12:3

stances.quote:

…I'm pretty sure we took care of that 16 years ago 😂

Congrats, Darline. You’re already making us proud!

stances.quote:
Lindsey loved South Carolina deeply. There was never a day he stopped fighting for the people of our state.

Through his military service and years in public office, he gave his all to protect America and our freedom-loving allies.

He was truly one of a kind.

stances.summary: Criticizes opponent's lack of national security expertise
stances.quote: Lindsey Graham was well informed on the United States’ national security. Darline Graham admits she’s not. This is not something you inherit. And it’s critical in the U.S. Senate.

stances.quote: Yes real crazy. My name on my birth certificate is Nikki. Was born and raised with that name. I married a Haley. Nikki Haley. Somehow makes me a weird Republican.

stances.summary: IOC wrongly cleared Russia to compete despite Ukraine invasion
stances.quote: Russia has been barred from competing in the Olympics since they started a war in Ukraine. Nothing has changed. It’s an absolute disgrace the IOC would clear them to compete while Putin continues to bomb Ukrainian cities and hold their land.
